title: Integration Services
snippet:
ZIS APIs are available on Suite Growth and above and Support Professional and above. If you're interested in becoming a Zendesk developer partner, you can convert a trial account into a sponsored Zendesk account. See [Getting a trial or sponsored account for development](/documentation/developer-tools/getting-started/getting-a-trial-or-sponsored-account-for-development/).

ZIS APIs use OAuth 2.0 for authenticating requests, unless stated otherwise. The OAuth access token must be associated with the ZIS integration specified in the request. To get this token, see [Obtaining a ZIS OAuth token](/documentation/integration-services/developer-guide/developing-private-zis-integrations/#obtaining-a-zis-oauth-token).

title: developer.zendesk.com/documentation/api-basics/getting-started/getting-a-trial-or-sponsored-account-for-development
snippet:
You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account. If you're interested in becoming a Zendesk developer partner, you can convert your trial account into a sponsored Zendesk Support account.
As part of becoming a Zendesk developer partner, Zendesk sponsors an instance for up to 5 agents that you can use for developing, demoing, and troubleshooting your app or integration.
Unlike a trial account, a sponsored account does not expire after 14 days.
By default, all Marketplace partners with a sponsored Support account receive the Suite Enterprise plan. A sponsored Sell account includes all features on the Sell Elite plan except the Firehouse, Sync, and Search APIs.

title: What are the Zendesk plan requirements for RingCentral's integration?
snippet: Answer When setting up a CTI integration such as; 8x8, RingCentral or Talk Desk, a Zendesk Talk Partner Edition plan is required. Talk Partner Edition is a Zendesk Talk plan that allows integrations to access the Talk API that is required for setting up the CTI integration. You can download CTI integration app from our Apps Marketplace, a Talk Partner Edition trial is automatically enabled when you first trigger the API. Placing a call from the integration will trigger the API. Once the API has been trigged you will be able to test the integration for up to 30 days, after which the trial will expire and you will be required to start a paid Talk Partner Edition plan. For more information on pricing of Talk Partner Edition, see Zendesk Talk Pricing.

title: About the Sunshine Profiles API
snippet:
1. Get Zendesk Support.
A Zendesk Support account with a Sunshine plan is required to use the API. Sunshine plans are available on the Support Enterprise or Suite Enterprise plans and above. For plan details, see [Plan availability](https://developer.zendesk.com/rest_api/docs/sunshine/introduction#plan-availability).
You can get a free, 14-day trial account. If you're interested in becoming a Zendesk developer partner, you can convert your trial account into a [sponsored Zendesk Support account](/hc/en-us/articles/360000036968).
You'll also need agent or admin permissions in the account to use the API.

title: Introduction
snippet:
The Zendesk Reseller API is only accessible to Zendesk partners and resellers. If you are a partner and want to gain access, email us at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection).
## Introduction
### What is this API?
The Zendesk Reseller API allows you, as a reseller partner of Zendesk, to create new Zendesk Support instances.
Zendesk partners can use the Reseller API to create Zendesk Support trial accounts. Partners can also configure the provisioned accounts with certain settings.
### How to get access?
The Zendesk Partner Portal allows you to create and manage Zendesk Support instances, as well as export account status, billing data, and leads linked to your referral or reseller account.

To become a Zendesk reseller or partner, complete the [Zendesk Partner application form](https://www.zendesk.com/partner/).
If you are already a partner and want to gain access to our Reseller API, email us at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#cdbdacbfb9a3a8bfbe8db7a8a3a9a8bea6e3aea2a0).

title: developer.zendesk.com/documentation/conversations/how-to-guides/building-a-marketplace-bot
snippet:
As an official Zendesk Technology Partner, you will be able to offer an OAuth flow in your application allowing your customers to provision you with access to their Zendesk messaging data. The first step in becoming a partner is to list your app, integration, or bot on the Zendesk Marketplace. See [Publishing your bot on the Zendesk Marketplace](https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/marketplace/#publishing-your-bot-in-the-zendesk-marketplace) for more information on the steps required.
## API requirements
Marketplace bots must include the `X-Zendesk-Marketplace-Name,` `X-Zendesk-Marketplace-Organization-Id,` and `X-Zendesk-Marketplace-Bot-Id` headers on all API requests. These values can be obtained when you [register your organization](https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/marketplace/publishing-to-the-marketplace/register-your-organization/) and [submit your bot](https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/marketplace/publishing-to-the-marketplace/submit-your-bot/) to the Zendesk Marketplace. See [Request header requirements for Marketplace apps](https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/marketplace/building-a-marketplace-app/request-header-requirements-for-marketplace-apps/) for more details.
## Implementing the OAuth flow
Once accepted as a Zendesk Technology Partner, you will be provisioned with a `client_id` and `client_secret` which you can use to implement an OAuth flow allowing your customers to grant you limited access to their Zendesk account's messaging data. The content below assumes that you are already familiar with the [OAuth 2.0 standard](https://oauth.net/2/). To learn more, see the [OAuth getting started guide](https://oauth.net/getting-started/).
Marketplace bot integrations must use the OAuth authentication process described in this section to make API calls. They must not use a customer’s own Sunshine Conversations API credentials.
